notes:
— Account summary: global finance advisory firm building cross-border research portal. Needs high-precision RAG for regulatory/legal queries.
— Scale: ~120M documents initially, growing 2–3x over 12–18 months. Expect bursts around earnings/regulatory events.
— Latency / throughput targets: p50 < 80ms overall, p99 < 220ms for search+rerank; baseline QPS target 200–300 sustained with spikes to 800.
— Cost sensitivity: target blended cost < $0.008/query (embeddings + HNSW ANN + lightweight reranker). Leadership skeptical of per-query costs with heavy rerankers.
— Multilingual requirements: 12 languages (EN, FR, DE, ES, IT, NL, PT, PL, RU, CS, AR, SV). Need per-language recall/precision tuning and monitoring; prefer per-language recall >= 0.85 for legal intents.
— Indexing architecture preferences: shard-by-language + per-shard ANN (HNSW) with periodic rebalancing; want recommendations on shard count, memory sizing, and compaction strategy.
— Models: evaluating mix — single multilingual embedding model (fast) vs per-language tuned models for edge languages (PL, CS, RU). Interested in configurable reranker: cross-lingual re-ranker vs language-specific BERT variants.
— Security/compliance: cannot allow plaintext EU customer docs to leave EU. "We cannot expose any legal docs outside the EU jurisdiction", CTO quote during security call. Requires SOC2 + ISO27001 certs, audit logs, SSO integration, and customer-managed KMS/HSM.
— POC asks: 1) sizing report for Dedicated cluster with expected mem/gpu for 120M docs; 2) cost-per-query model for 3 POC configurations (multilingual baseline, per-language embeddings, multilingual + cross-lingual reranker); 3) sample per-language precision/recall dashboard and alerting hooks.
— Favored Redwood features: automatic prefix/KV caching, smart routing (by language/latency), and Optimize's quantization recommendations.
— Quote from Head of Search: "We need predictable economics — a single number for per-query cost at 95th percentile QPS, otherwise procurement will kill it."
— Next: deliver POC sizing + cost model; schedule infra deep-dive with their platform team; legal to review draft DPA.
